title: caret after East Asian wide characters
notes: E-PARSE-001 with six CJK characters before the caret. Each occupies two terminal columns, and a caret padded by code points sat six cells left of the quote it labelled. `_excerpt` pads by `display_width` now, so the caret is under the quote in a monospace terminal; in this file the caret line is longer than the column by the same six cells.
